attributes.text: The Ray-Ban Aviator Classic, in Gold / Green G-15. The pilot shape is about as universally flattering as eyewear gets — the teardrop softens a square jaw and adds length to a rounder face. This size measures 58mm across each lens, which is on the wider side. The lenses block 100% of UV as the brand supplies them, and I can swap in polarised if you would rather. Prescription lenses go in this frame without any trouble — single vision or varifocal — and I cut and fit them here.

items.text: Boxed with the brand's own case, cloth and two-year manufacturer's warranty — claims handled by me, not a call centre
Prescription lenses available in this frame — single vision or varifocal

attributes.title: Will prescription lenses work in these?

attributes.text: Yes — single vision or varifocal. Frames with a strong curve suit prescriptions up to about ±4.00 best. I check yours before cutting anything and will suggest an alternative if this pair isn't the one…
The frame, the brand's own hard case, a cleaning cloth and the manufacturer's warranty card. Nothing is unboxed, resealed or third-party.
Free UK delivery over £75, otherwise £3.95 tracked. Free collection in Birmingham. 30 days to return unworn frames; prescription lenses are refundable only if I got them wrong.
Bring them in any time and I'll straighten, tighten or re-fit them for nothing, whether you bought them here last week or last year.
Bought with single vision lenses and the tint matches the originals exactly. Nobody can tell they're prescription.
Ordered Friday, arrived Tuesday, boxed with the case and cloth. Genuine article, £40 less than anywhere else I looked.
Wasn't sure about the size so I asked first. Got told straight that the smaller one would suit me better — it did.
